newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Xeikon hopes to triple press sales by '98.
newsitem.headline: Xeikon hopes to triple press sales by '98.

text.p: Nasdaq-listed Belgian digital printing press maker Xeikon NV hopes to triple press sales by 1998, chief executive officer Lucien De Schampelaere said in a newspaper interview.

"In 1997, we will double the number of sales teams across the world and, in 1998, we hope to be able to triple the number of presses sold," De Schampelaere told newspaper La Libre Belgique's Saturday edition.
De Schampelaere said the measures were designed to combat flat growth in turnover between 1995 and 1996. He noted, however, 1996 operating profit amounted to 600 million francs.
